units.source_text: 忠左卫门被烟呛了一下，难说的笑了笑。

en.t: Chuzaemon choked on the smoke and smiled in a hard-to-describe way.

units.source_text: 奋笔疾书的小野寺十内似乎若有所思，

en.t: Onodera Junai, writing furiously, seemed to be lost in thought,

units.source_text: 他抬了抬头，目光又马上落在纸上，继续认真写下去。

en.t: He lifted his head slightly, but his gaze at once dropped back to the paper, and he went on writing earnestly.

units.source_text: 他可能是正给在身在京都的妻子写信呢吧。

en.t: He was probably in the middle of writing a letter to his wife in Kyoto.
